what: Chapter 04 of the introduction at its rest: the starting grid, every battery planned for Nov 26 as one column.

render.command: packages/world: sh scripts/serve.sh <port>, then node scripts/render.mjs --port <port> --frames _objects.chapter-starting-grid --out <dir> --w 1280 --h 720 --scale 2 --plates 0 --raw --repeat 2
